lines.zh: 林子深处有什么在移动
lines.en: Something moves deep in the woods.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在飘
lines.en: I move slowly, as if drifting.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树之间断断续续
lines.en: My shadow breaks and joins between trees.

lines.zh: 我的脚步压着落叶，几乎没有声
lines.en: My steps press the leaves almost silently.

lines.zh: 我绕着那圈空地走
lines.en: I circle that clearing.

lines.zh: 树枝在我经过时不再摇
lines.en: The branches stop swaying as I pass.

lines.zh: 我朝着有灯的方向去
lines.en: I head toward the light.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地把林子让开
lines.en: Step by step the woods part for me.

lines.zh: 我的身影比树还高
lines.en: My shape stands taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，鸟都不叫了
lines.en: Where I pass, the birds stop calling.

lines.zh: 我在树后停了一下，再继续
lines.en: I pause behind a tree, then go on.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树滑到另一棵
lines.en: I slide from one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 我停在林间，不动
lines.en: I stop among the trees, still.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在暗处看不清楚
lines.en: My outline blurs in the dark.

lines.zh: 远处有一盏灯在晃
lines.en: A light sways far off.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，或者听不出来
lines.en: I do not breathe, or it cannot be heard.

lines.zh: 我像一棵长错了的树
lines.en: I am like a tree that grew wrong.

lines.zh: 林子静得反常
lines.en: The woods are unnaturally quiet.

lines.zh: 我等，等有人往这边看
lines.en: I wait for someone to look this way.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，形状不像人
lines.en: My shadow lies on the ground in no human shape.

lines.zh: 风绕过我，改了方向
lines.en: The wind goes around me and changes course.

lines.zh: 我没有动，可我在靠近
lines.en: I have not moved, yet I am nearer.

lines.zh: 我在树影里看着你
lines.en: I watch you from the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 你已经走到这里了
lines.en: You have come this far already.

lines.zh: 你四处找，找不到我
lines.en: You search and do not find me.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树后面有人
lines.en: There is someone behind that tree behind you.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在动，只是很慢
lines.en: My outline moves, only very slowly.

lines.zh: 你听见林子里没有虫叫吗
lines.en: Do you hear the insects have stopped?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，比树影还暗。
lines.en: My eyes are darker than the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 你抬头，树冠上没有鸟
lines.en: Look up: no birds in the canopy.

lines.zh: 我不说话，也不需要
lines.en: I do not speak, nor need to.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到我身上
lines.en: Your lamp does not reach me.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓晃了一下
lines.en: My outline wavers.

lines.zh: 我退进树影里
lines.en: I withdraw into the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 树林里的声音停了一瞬
lines.en: The sounds of the woods stop for a moment.

lines.zh: 我离树更近了一步
lines.en: I come a step closer to the trees.

lines.zh: 我发出的声音像风穿过空枝
lines.en: I sound like wind through bare branches.

lines.zh: 我矮下去一截
lines.en: I grow a little shorter.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓有一块淡了
lines.en: A patch of my outline has faded.

lines.zh: 树影重新把我盖住
lines.en: The tree shadows cover me again.

lines.zh: 林子里所有的叶子同时响
lines.en: Every leaf in the woods sounds at once.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一步，落叶没有压弯
lines.en: I step back and no leaf bends.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，像在试探
lines.en: You hold it up as if testing.

lines.zh: 我不吃这些，可我会靠近
lines.en: I do not eat such things, but I will come close.

lines.zh: 林子里的东西不吃人间的东西
lines.en: Things in these woods do not eat what men eat.

lines.zh: 我离你近了一些
lines.en: I have come a little nearer.

lines.zh: 你手上的光比我的亮
lines.en: The light in your hand is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我就退开
lines.en: Set it down and I will withdraw.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我知道那是什么
lines.en: I have no mouth, yet I know what it is.

lines.zh: 你把光调暗，我就再近些
lines.en: Dim your light and I come nearer.

lines.zh: 这点气味在林中散得很快
lines.en: This scent scatters fast in the woods.

lines.zh: 我停在一个安全的距离上
lines.en: I stop at a safe distance.

lines.zh: 你撞上了什么，很硬
lines.en: You hit something, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 我退开一尺，落叶没有动
lines.en: I retreat a foot and no leaf stirs.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，抓到的是空的
lines.en: You reach out and catch nothing.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你身上穿过去
lines.en: My shadow passes through you.

lines.zh: 你踩到的地面比别处冷
lines.en: The ground you step on is colder than the rest.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，是你撞上来的
lines.en: I did not move; you walked into me.

lines.zh: 你撞到的地方，什么也没有
lines.en: You hit a place where nothing is.

lines.zh: 树皮上留下了你的手印
lines.en: Your handprint stays on the bark.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀被一只看不见的手按住
lines.en: An unseen hand presses your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我让开半尺，落叶还是不动
lines.en: I give half a foot and no leaf stirs.

lines.zh: 林子里还有一个这样的
lines.en: There is another like this in the woods.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，只是对着
lines.en: We do not approach; we only face.

lines.zh: 两处暗影在树间相对
lines.en: Two patches of dark face each other between trees.

lines.zh: 林子里，只有我们两个影子。
lines.en: In the woods, only our two shadows.

lines.zh: 它退开了，我也退开
lines.en: It withdraws, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我们一起往林子更深处去
lines.en: We head deeper into the woods together.

lines.zh: 两片阴影像门一样合上
lines.en: Two shadows close like a door.

lines.zh: 它先走，我跟在后面
lines.en: It goes first; I follow.

lines.zh: 我们不需要说话，林子替我们说
lines.en: We need no words; the woods speak for us.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着你的灯
lines.en: Together we watch your lamp.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我没有手去拿
lines.en: Something lies there; I have no hand to take it.

lines.zh: 我让它留在原处
lines.en: I leave it where it is.

lines.zh: 我围着它转了半圈
lines.en: I circle it half way.

lines.zh: 它在我看过之后就旧了
lines.en: After I look at it, it seems older.

lines.zh: 我没有留下脚印
lines.en: I leave no footprints.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，落叶被推开
lines.en: I circle it and the leaves are pushed aside.

lines.zh: 它在我看着的时候变冷
lines.en: It grows cold under my gaze.

lines.zh: 地上没有脚印，只有枯叶少了
lines.en: No prints, only fewer dead leaves.

lines.zh: 我把它记住了，虽然带不走
lines.en: I remember it, though I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我再回来时它还在这里
lines.en: When I return, it will still be here.

lines.zh: 我停在树后，完全不动
lines.en: I stop behind the tree, utterly still.

lines.zh: 林子里的声音全没了
lines.en: Every sound in the woods is gone.

lines.zh: 你成了这里唯一在动的东西
lines.en: You are the only thing moving here.

lines.zh: 我在暗处把方向调正
lines.en: I align myself in the dark.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，可我知道你在哪
lines.en: You cannot see me, but I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我不需要去追你
lines.en: I need not chase you.

lines.zh: 我把身形压低，藏进树干
lines.en: I lower my shape behind a trunk.

lines.zh: 林子里连风都停了
lines.en: Even the wind has stopped in the woods.

lines.zh: 你的灯成了唯一的方向
lines.en: Your lamp is the only direction now.

lines.zh: 我从暗处看着你数呼吸
lines.en: I watch you count your breaths from the dark.

lines.zh: 你身上那点热度很显眼
lines.en: The little warmth in you stands out.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，没有抬多高
lines.en: I raise a hand, not very high.

lines.zh: 树影在我身上移动
lines.en: Tree shadows crawl across me.

lines.zh: 我只需要等你走错一步
lines.en: I only need you to take one wrong step.

lines.zh: 这片林子的规矩你还不懂
lines.en: You do not yet know this wood's rules.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，从你进林子起
lines.en: I have been behind you since you entered.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声，你听不见。
lines.en: You cannot hear my footsteps.

lines.zh: 你回头，那里只有树
lines.en: You look back and there are only trees.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的灯走
lines.en: I follow your lamp.

lines.zh: 你走快，我也快一点
lines.en: Walk faster and I quicken a little.

lines.zh: 你不該来这片林子
lines.en: You should not have come to these woods.

lines.zh: 我在树间移动，一直不出声
lines.en: I move among the trees, never making a sound.

lines.zh: 你数着树，我就多数一棵
lines.en: Count the trees; I am one more.

lines.zh: 你走的方向是往林子深处
lines.en: You are heading deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 我把你往没有出口的地方引
lines.en: I steer you where there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我躲在树干后，四肢很瘦。
lines.en: I hide behind the trunk, all thin limbs.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到的地方没有我
lines.en: Your lamp never shows me.

lines.zh: 我从你的左侧换到右侧
lines.en: I slip from your left to your right.

lines.zh: 你回头看的路已经变了
lines.en: The way behind you has changed.

lines.zh: 林子里的声音越来越远
lines.en: The sounds of the woods draw farther off.

lines.zh: 我让树枝在你面前合上
lines.en: I let the branches close before you.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，方向就乱了
lines.en: Once you run, your direction is lost.

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是不让你看见
lines.en: I am always here, only unseen.

lines.zh: 你听见的是我踩过的落叶
lines.en: What you hear is the leaves I crossed.

lines.zh: 这一圈林子你走不出去
lines.en: You will not walk out of this ring.

lines.zh: 我在等你的灯油烧完
lines.en: I am waiting for your lamp to burn out.

lines.zh: 有东西从树后伸出来
lines.en: Something reaches out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 你被撞了一下，看不见人
lines.en: Something hits you, and there is no one to see.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，很冷
lines.en: I press your shoulder, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯忽然灭了
lines.en: The lamp in your hand suddenly dies.

lines.zh: 你一转身，什么也没有
lines.en: You turn, and there is nothing.

lines.zh: 有一只手按在你的后颈
lines.en: A hand settles on your nape.

lines.zh: 你被推得撞上一棵树
lines.en: You are shoved into a tree.

lines.zh: 我的影子从你身上过了一遍
lines.en: My shadow passes over you once.

lines.zh: 你的耳边有风声，不是风
lines.en: There is wind at your ear, and it is not wind.

lines.zh: 你摔倒在地，落叶没有动
lines.en: You fall, and no leaf stirs.

lines.zh: 你挥了一下，打中是树干
lines.en: You swing and hit a trunk.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领又松开
lines.en: I take your collar and let go.

lines.zh: 你的面前忽然没有路
lines.en: Suddenly there is no path in front of you.

lines.zh: 你被转了半圈，找不到灯
lines.en: You are spun half around and lose your lamp.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的呼吸，很响
lines.en: You hear your own breathing, loud.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的背站着
lines.en: I stand close against your back.

lines.zh: 我一松手，你扑了个空
lines.en: I let go and you lunge at nothing.

lines.zh: 你退到树根上，摔了一下
lines.en: You back onto a root and stumble.

lines.zh: 那片空地忽然暗了
lines.en: That clearing has suddenly gone dark.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西被打掉了
lines.en: What you held has been struck from your hand.

lines.zh: 林子里多了一片阴影
lines.en: A patch of shadow has been added to the woods.

lines.zh: 鸟全飞起来，朝一个方向
lines.en: The birds all rise and fly one way.

lines.zh: 树梢上的叶子忽然全静了
lines.en: The leaves in the canopy suddenly go still.

lines.zh: 我出现在两棵树之间
lines.en: I appear between two trees.

lines.zh: 林子边上，我站直了。
lines.en: At the treeline, I stand up straight.

lines.zh: 这一带从今天起不太平
lines.en: This stretch will not be quiet from today.

lines.zh: 先静下来的是虫声
lines.en: The insects go quiet first.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树之间成形
lines.en: I take shape between two trees.

lines.zh: 林子边缘的风停了
lines.en: The wind at the wood's edge stops.

lines.zh: 一只鹿忽然抬头，跑了
lines.en: A deer lifts its head and bolts.

lines.zh: 这里的影子比别处多一个
lines.en: There is one more shadow here than before.

lines.zh: 我站的位置原先只是空地
lines.en: Where I stand was only empty ground.

lines.zh: 火光靠近，我往外退了很远
lines.en: The fire comes near and I retreat far.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下去，落地没有声音
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land without sound.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的轮廓散在水里
lines.en: Water rises and my outline dissolves in it.

lines.zh: 爆光把林子照亮，我无处可藏
lines.en: The blast lights the woods and I have nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，留下一道空
lines.en: Something passes through me, leaving a gap.

lines.zh: 那股力量抓住我的形状
lines.en: That force takes hold of my shape.

lines.zh: 我不吃，也不会饿
lines.en: I do not eat, and never hunger.

lines.zh: 雷光把整片林子照白，我缩进阴影
lines.en: Lightning whitens the woods and I shrink into shadow.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我散开了
lines.en: No ground beneath; I come apart.
